catalogViews.name: workshop-overview
catalogViews.description: Complete original Clockwind Workshop circuit with both physical fork roads, banked helical spool climb, open height-separated crossing, connected wooden benches and modeled clockmaker landmarks. Exact emitted static source geometry, approximate offline lighting.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/workshop-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: workshop-topdown
catalogViews.description: True overhead source geometry, including both independently sampled physical roads: the technical Cabinet Chicane and broad Workbench Rim. Real split/merge geometry and the upper/lower road crossing retain their actual elevations.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/workshop-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: workshop-helix-crossing
catalogViews.description: Source-accurate three-quarter spool climb around the original clock heart, continuous graded support and open overhead crossing. Road camber, elevations, underside and separated lower road are unmodified.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/workshop-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: workshop-clockheart-detail
catalogViews.description: Original modeled clock heart: source dial faces, hands, bezel, static toothed gears, frame, spindle bosses and grounded pedestal. The gear teeth and silhouette are actual mesh geometry.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/workshop-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: workshop-cabinet-detail
catalogViews.description: Original workshop cabinet assembly with actual recessed drawer fronts, pulls, tool silhouettes and grounded wooden construction. Only the emitted source meshes are shown.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/workshop-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit

catalogViews.name: workshop-vise-detail
catalogViews.description: Original vise assembly: source fixed and moving jaws, static threaded rod, cross-handle and bolted mounting plinth. This is a static modeled landmark, not an animated clamping interaction.
catalogViews.poseSource: Exact pre-enrichment docs/workshop-preview-provenance.json pose; no refit
